annotations.title: Cheapest way to send money abroad

description: Ranks money transfer providers by total cost (fee plus exchange-rate margin) for sending $200 or $500 from the US to Mexico, India or the Philippines, from the World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide survey (Q3 2025), with the corridor average, the ECB reference rate in that currency and providers' published fee rules. Filter by how the recipient gets the money.

amount_usd.description: Amount sent in US dollars: 200 or 500 (the two amounts the World Bank surveys). Default 200.

country.description: Destination: Mexico, India or Philippines (country name, ISO code MX/IN/PH or currency MXN/INR/PHP).

limit.description: How many providers to return, cheapest first. Default 10.

receiving_method.description: Optional: only providers paying out to a bank account, cash pickup or mobile wallet.

name: find_cheapest_way_to_send_money
title: Cheapest way to send money abroad
